description: Header file defining the internal structures and API for a cuckoo hash table implementation in jemalloc, including type definitions, function prototypes, and macros.

methods.name: ckh_new
methods.description: Initializes a new cuckoo hash table with specified minimum capacity, hash function, and key comparison function.

methods.name: ckh_delete
methods.description: Deletes and frees resources associated with the hash table.

methods.name: ckh_count
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the hash table.

methods.name: ckh_iter
methods.description: Iterates over the hash table elements, updating key and data pointers.

methods.name: ckh_insert
methods.description: Inserts a key-data pair into the hash table.

methods.name: ckh_remove
methods.description: Removes an element by key from the hash table, returning the key and data.

methods.name: ckh_search
methods.description: Searches for an element by key in the hash table.
